definitions.explanation: To accept something as true or to have faith in something.
To have confidence in someone or something's reliability.

examples.japanese: あなたを{信|しん}じています。
その{話|はなし}は{信|しん}じられない。
{自分|じぶん}を{信|しん}じることが{大切|たいせつ}です。
examples.english: It's important to believe in yourself.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xを{信|しん}じる (believe X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing state. {信|しん}じている = 'believe' (continuous state of believing).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{人|ひと}を{信|しん}じる (believe in a person)
・{話|はなし}を{信|しん}じる (believe a story)
・{自分|じぶん}を{信|しん}じる (believe in oneself)
・{信|しん}じられない (I can't believe it)

Related: {信頼|しんらい} (trust - noun), {信用|しんよう} (credit/trust). {信|しん}じられない is very common in conversation.
